origin.description: Change named locale categories, then restore them.

arguments.name: _new
arguments.text: Mapping of category names to locale names.

origin.details: Setting LC_ALL is an error. LC_COLLATE also sets the LC_COLLATE environment variable, which R consults ahead of the locale.
origin.example:
x <- c("bernard", "bérénice", "béatrice", "boris")
before <- Sys.getlocale("LC_COLLATE")
out <- local({
  local_locale(c(LC_COLLATE = "fr_FR.UTF-8"))
  sort(x)
})
c(out, if (identical(Sys.getlocale("LC_COLLATE"), before)) "restored" else "open")

translation.description: Change named locale categories, then restore them.

arguments.name: _new
arguments.text: Mapping of category names to locale names.

translation.details: Setting LC_ALL is an error. LC_COLLATE also sets the LC_COLLATE environment variable, which R consults ahead of the locale. code is a callable, and local_* is a context manager.
translation.example:
import os
import tempfile
from withr import *

import locale
x = ["bernard", "bérénice", "béatrice", "boris"]
before = locale.setlocale(locale.LC_COLLATE)
with local_locale({"LC_COLLATE": "fr_FR.UTF-8"}):
    out = sorted(x, key=locale.strxfrm)
after = locale.setlocale(locale.LC_COLLATE)
return out + ["restored" if after == before else "open"]
